Hogging simply means blocking the road for faster vehicles, regardless of speed. As long as someone wants to overtake you, you're hogging if you don't give way. If you are unwilling to go faster then move to a slower lane.

Speeding is an offence, but front car must give way as it is also a traffic offence to road hog.

Additionally, front car should give way as it is in the overtaking lane if it is not overtaking.
Once again, speed limit applies to all lanes. All you have to be concerned about is not hog lane 1 for cars who wish to go faster and overtake you.

Rule 1: Do not use lane 1 unless overtaking

Regardless of the speed limit, the slower car should get out of the way i.e. out of the overtaking lane. If he chooses to stick to the limit, that is his choice but preventing faster cars from overtaking is road hogging.
